test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can complete a piece of work in 12 days and B can complete it in 20 days. If they work on alternate days, starting with B on first day, then in how many days will the work be finished?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete a piece of work in 12 days.

B can complete a piece of work in 20 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/12

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/20

**Calculation:**

Work done by B on the 1st day = 1/20

Work done by A on the 2nd day = 1/12

Work done in 2 days = 1/20 + 1/12

⇒ Work done in 2 days = (1/20) + (1/12)

⇒ Work done in 2 days = (3 + 5)/60 = 8/60 = 2/15

Work done in 2 days = 2/15

Work done in 14 days (7 cycles) = 7 × (2/15)

⇒ Work done in 14 days = 14/15

Remaining work after 14 days = 1 - 14/15

⇒ Remaining work = 1/15

B will come on 15th day and does 1/20 work.

Remaining A come and does = 1/15 - 1/20 = (4-3) / 60 = 1 /60. 

Time taken by A to complete 1/60 work = (1/60) / (1/12)

⇒ Time taken by A = 12/60

⇒ Time taken by A = 1/5 days

Total time to complete the work = 14 + 1 + 1/5 days

⇒ Total time = 15 1/5 days

 

**The work will be finished in 15 1****/****5** **days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

LCM (12,20) = 60 = Total work.

A does = 60/12 = 5 units of work in one day.

B does = 60/20 = 3 units of work in one day.

Starting with work done in 2 days = 3+5 = 8 units.

8 × 7 = 56 units that means 7 more such cycles of 2 days needed, that is 14 days.

On 15th ay B come and does 3 units of work that is 59 units. 

1 unit left A will come does in 1/5 days.

So, total number of days = 14 + 1 +1/5 = 15 1/5 days
